sourcePolicy: Local working tree, tests, diagnostics, scripts, RefPlan5 and local Git history only; no remote Git.

phaseGate.input: Verified Phase 03 topology, Phase 06 Canonical IR and Phase 08A TargetMachine/register contracts.
phaseGate.output: Stable virtual/precolored values, explicit allocation constraints, PHI-edge and loop liveness, half-open intervals, and deterministic class/group/port-pressure evidence.
phaseGate.authorityBoundary: Value analysis is compiler-owned observational evidence only. It does not allocate physical registers, model runtime rename/PRF occupancy, authorize runtime legality/execution/publication/commit/retire, or change scheduler policy.
phaseGate.deterministicFallback: Unknown/mismatched target constraints and unsupported vector/special-state allocation fail closed as Unknown/Unsupported; deterministic production budget exhaustion returns BudgetExhausted without changing the existing schedule.

valueModel.architecturalRegisterOperands: IrOperandKind.ArchitecturalRegister; legacy Pointer remains a compatibility-only classifier/lowering/safety-mask input
valueModel.zeroRegisterPolicy: x0 is fixed-zero/discard and is excluded from value/dependency flow

prequalificationDiagnostics.cause: The Phase 07 explicit ArchitecturalRegister operand kind was not consumed by the legacy compiler-side SafetyMaskDiagnosticChecker, suppressing three safety-mask conflicts and changing the nested Phase 02 runtime-bridge golden hash.
prequalificationDiagnostics.disposition: Corrected in 87222851 by accepting canonical ArchitecturalRegister and legacy Pointer at the single compatibility seam; the four isolated regressions then passed 4/4 without changing golden data or runtime code.

releaseDisposition.defaultEnabledScope: Observational native value-flow, liveness and pressure reports attached to Canonical IR schedules; scheduling and emitted artifacts retain the existing path.
releaseDisposition.releaseDisposition: Qualified for Phase 08B consumption; final release authorization remains owned by Phase 27.

nextDependencyGate.gate: Complete the full ABI, address-space, memory, object, relocation, linker and platform contract on top of verified Phase 07 values/liveness and the Phase 08A target core; unsupported ABI/object cases remain fail closed.
